detail.longDescription: OK...  so here is a thing...  a significant part of the devs now use AI agents... but, unless you look at the details of a commit message, this is not really clear if this is to become the new standard, should # git not make it possible to make a distinction between the dev's own commits and those of his agents? and should this also not be visible in tools like # gitlab or # github (without the need to buy additional licences, same user with different aliases or something)? thoughts about this?
